cases.customer_question: How should a Bluetooth product using a prequalified module, Bluetooth Mesh, GATT, beacon functions, and Nordic SDK components be qualified using Multi-Design references?
question_variants: Can Mesh and GATT be covered in one qualification?
Which QDIDs must be referenced for Mesh plus beacon functionality?
Can I qualify using Nordic Mesh Subsystem and a module qualification together?
How do I build a Multi-Design declaration for a Mesh product?
What qualification references are required for nRF Connect SDK implementations?
cases.actual_issue: The product uses both Bluetooth Mesh functionality and standard Bluetooth functionality, requiring qualification coverage from multiple qualified designs rather than a single qualification reference.
cases.plain_english_explanation: A Bluetooth Mesh qualification does not automatically cover all standard Bluetooth functions. If a product uses Mesh together with normal Bluetooth communication such as GATT or beaconing, multiple qualification records may need to be referenced. The qualification must match the actual software components implemented in the product.
cases.consultant_answer: Bluetooth Mesh Subsystem qualifications cover Mesh functionality only. Standard GATT and beacon functionality must be covered through the applicable module or SoftDevice qualification references. Qualification eligibility depends on the actual SDK and software versions implemented. The final qualification should use a Multi-Design approach that combines the required qualified designs corresponding to the implemented components.
cases.decision_logic: Each implemented Bluetooth function must be covered by a valid qualified design. Mesh qualification covers Mesh functionality, while GATT and beacon functionality require separate qualified references. Qualification reuse is only valid when the referenced qualified designs match the implemented software versions and components.
cases.final_recommendation: Identify the exact SDK, SoftDevice, Mesh subsystem, and module versions implemented in the product and build a Multi-Design declaration using the corresponding qualified designs that collectively cover all implemented Bluetooth functionality.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Assuming the Mesh qualification alone covers all Bluetooth functionality can result in an incomplete declaration, qualification inconsistencies, and delays in completing qualification.
